title: pyrola picta subsp. integra
intro: Pyrola picta subsp. integra, commonly known as Western Wintergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family (Ericaceae). The plant is prized for its leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in digestion, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Western Wintergreen include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which can help relieve coughs and congestion, reduce swelling, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Western Wintergreen include methyl salicylate, salicylic acid, and other volatile compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
